text:
morgan: heads up — admission-controller alerted on prod: image digest drift for redwood/runtime:release-2026-02-14. expected sha256:aaa111... got sha256:bbb222... :eyes:

sam: I'm oncall. which pods/nodes?

morgan: pods: runtime-rc-7f9c (node=gk-prod-5), runtime-rc-7f9d (node=gk-prod-3). saw `Image signature verification failed` in admission logs. quick snippet:
```
AdmissionController: image verification failed: manifest digest mismatch
expected: sha256:aaa111...
observed: sha256:bbb222...
annotation: cosign.sigstore.dev/signature: MISSING
```

alex: hmm. did the registry recently re-sign or was there a key rotation? any CI deploys around that time?

morgan: CI pipeline shows a successful deploy at 2026-06-11T03:12Z from `ci-deployer@prod-sa`. Katy-bot shows a pipeline triggered at 03:11Z. but registry manifest history indicates manifest history changed at 03:11:45Z.

priia (typo) — actually: priya: checking KMS audit for the same window. I see a spike of Decrypt calls around 03:10-03:14Z from service-account `ci-deployer@infra` (different SA than expected). log excerpt:
```
2026-06-11T03:11:10Z KMS Decrypt project=redwood-prod principal=sa:ci-deployer@infra request_id=req-7af2
2026-06-11T03:11:42Z KMS Decrypt project=redwood-prod principal=sa:ci-deployer@infra request_id=req-7af3
```

morgan: that's the weird bit — deploy pipeline usually uses `ci-deployer@prod-sa`. why is `infra` SA hitting KMS? :thinking_face:

sam: possible auth token leak or impersonation via WorkloadIdentity? check recent RBAC changes.

alex: I pulled the registry manifest. tag `release-2026-02-14` now points to digest bbb222. previous digest (aaa111) still present as an untagged manifest. suggests retagging or a force-push. can we temporarily block that tag and evict pods using that tag?

morgan: I'm going to cordon gk-prod-5 and evict runtime pods on that node. also adding an admission-policy rule to block images with missing cosign annotation for the tag.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline #7423 started by ci-deployer@infra — status: running.

priay: (typo) priya: KMS owner console shows a key rotation event at 2026-06-10T22:05Z but rotation was scheduled and expected. the weird bit is the principal — `ci-deployer@infra` should not have Decrypt permission on the signing key. I'll open an IAM audit.

alex: containment steps we should run now:
- revoke short-lived tokens for both `ci-deployer` SAs
- add a temporary deny binding on the signing KMS key for `ci-deployer@infra`
- block image tag `release-2026-02-14` at the registry (prevent pulls)
- rollback workloads to digest sha256:aaa111...
- rotate the signing key if we confirm compromise

sam: executing revokes + cordon now. posting commands I'm running:
```
# cordon node
kubectl cordon gk-prod-5
# evict pods
kubectl delete pod runtime-rc-7f9c -n production
# block tag (registry API)
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://registry.internal/api/block-tag -d '{"repo":"redwood/runtime","tag":"release-2026-02-14"}'
```

sam: cordon + evict done. registry tag block API returned 200. runtime services have been been rolled back via k8s replicaset to older digest.

morgan: confirmation from admission logs — new pulls for tag `release-2026-02-14` are now rejected with policy block. :lock:

priay: IAM audit shows a recent binding added 2026-06-10T21:59Z granting `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `serviceAccount:ci-deployer@infra`. change came from an automation PR in infra repo (PR #1127). tagging infra-owners.

alex: looks like an incorrect RBAC change in infra repo gave the wrong SA KMS access and that's what allowed the pipeline under `infra` to decrypt signing material. good catch.

morgan: next steps: 1) revert the IAM binding in infra repo and roll it out 2) rotate the signing key (and re-sign desired images) 3) run full CVE/vuln scan on the epoch of changed image 4) postmortem & update runbook (we need detection for unexpected KMS principals)

priay: I'll revert IAM change (PR revert queued) and start KMS key rotation. also will create an alert for KMS decrypts by principals not in the allowed list.

sam: remote-checklist:
- [x] cordon node and evict pods
- [x] block registry tag
- [x] revoke tokens for SA
- [ ] rotate signing key (in progress)
- [ ] full image scan + provenance verification

morgan: assign owners for follow-ups: priya -> KMS/keys rotation + alerting; alex -> registry/re-sign and provenance; sam -> runbook updates + postmortem writeup; i'll coordinate customer comms if needed.

priay: note for postmortem: include timeline of RBAC change PR #1127, which CI jobs used which SA, and list of images touched.

alex: one more note — add a policy test to CI to fail if any infra PR grants KMS roles outside `infra-svc-*` pattern.

sam: thanks everyone. I'll stay on until signing key rotation completes. updating channel in 30m. :thumbsup:

morgan: good work. tagging security@redwood for visibility and starting incident doc. :spiral_note_pad:

katy-bot: pipeline #7423 canceled by system due to revoked credentials.

morgan: final status for thread: blocked bad tag, reverted IAM binding queued, revoke done, rollback in prod. leaving open for postmortem items.
